summary: Verified all three bug fixes. BACKEND: POST /api/vacancy-alerts/subscribe returns 200 {ok:true, unsubscribe_token}, subscription persists (GET /api/vacancy-alerts/status -> subscribed:true), and backend logs show real Resend delivery ('Email sent via Resend to delivered@resend.dev ... id=ee7f4013-...') — no DEV MODE fallback. Invalid email -> 422, no filters -> 400. FRONTEND: header topbar-contact-btn href=https://wa.me/918168762016?text=<hindi msg>, target=_blank, click opens popup at api.whatsapp.com/send/?phone=918168762016 — works. JobAlertSubscribe expand -> email delivered@resend.dev -> SSC -> submit shows job-alert-success ('अलर्ट चालू हो गया ✔'). Push button with stubbed Notification.requestPermission='granted': exactly ONE toast, data-type=success, text 'Push Alerts ON — nayi bharti aate hi notification milegi.' and push-subscribe-status 'Push Alerts ON ✓' rendered within 1.5s. Iteration-4 wrong-error-toast defect is resolved.

issues: Pre-existing, unrelated pageerror on load: "Unexpected token 'E', \"Error 4: S\"... is not valid JSON" — a third-party script (likely Webpushr with placeholder site key) parsing a plain-text error as JSON. Harmless to flows tested but pollutes console; consider removing/guarding the SDK until a real key is set.
In real Chromium the notification permission is natively 'denied', so the button renders 'Push Blocked — Settings देखें' — expected behaviour, not a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: emails.py docstring still says 'Uses SMTP if all SMTP_* env vars are set, otherwise logs to console' — update to mention Resend precedence.
send_email() return type doc says mode: 'smtp'|'log' but 'resend' is now possible; keep docstrings in sync.
seed_data_creation: vacancy_subscriptions doc for delivered@resend.dev (Resend test sink) created/upserted by tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Push-notification granted path can only be tested by stubbing window.Notification via context.add_init_script (Chromium reports 'denied' natively and grant_permissions does not change it). Use [data-sonner-toast] with data-type attribute to distinguish success vs error toasts. Only use delivered@resend.dev as email recipient. Regression pytest file: /app/backend/tests/test_vacancy_alerts_email.py (also asserts the Resend log line, so run it after backend restarts).
rca_of_the_issue: All three previously reported defects are fixed at source: Resend branch added to emails.py send paths; header CTA changed from tel: to wa.me link with target=_blank; PushSubscribeButton isolates the webpushr handoff in its own try/catch so the SDK TypeError no longer diverts control past toast.success().
